must: Keep source-region traceability visible throughout review
Distinguish matched, low-confidence, unanswered, and unmatched states
Remain usable as a stacked layout on small screens
avoid: Decorative visuals that compete with scanned document content

decisions.decision: Use a colorful pastel anime and pixel-art visual language with crisp plum outlines, offset shadows, and compact review density.
decisions.reason: The user selected a playful anime/pixelated direction while the assessment workflow still needs clear status differentiation and source-document focus.

decisions.decision: Use an original wide pixel-art sunflower field, generated from the user's scenery and style references, as the active upload-screen background.
decisions.reason: The user selected a bright sunflower scene and a painterly 16-bit landscape treatment for the student-facing first page.

decisions.decision: Reserve the first viewport exclusively for the sunflower scenery and move the complete upload experience to a second full section below it.
decisions.reason: The user requested an uncluttered first page with all interface content relocated to page two.

decisions.decision: Use a plain VedaAI wordmark, a minimal purple-and-cream pixel assistant button with a beige hover state, and Instrument Serif Italic for all three elevated scenery-headline lines.
decisions.reason: The user requested one consistent cursive display face matching the supplied high-contrast editorial reference and asked for the composition to sit higher in the viewport.

decisions.decision: Use a light beige grid background with one enlarged, viewport-centered upload workspace, removing the redundant header, introductory hero, and Quest Path footer.
decisions.reason: The user wanted a softer, focused second page where the two document upload cards are the single dominant element at the exact center.

decisions.decision: Do not display bounding-box overlays on extracted answers in the review workspace.
decisions.reason: The user prefers a clean reading surface without the detached pink region rectangles.

decisions.decision: Prioritize larger, highly legible question and mapping-detail typography across desktop and phone review layouts.
decisions.reason: The user requested clearer reading sizes for assessment content and status information.

decisions.decision: Show unanswered questions as a centered pixel-style notice in soft red warning colors on the answer-sheet page.
decisions.reason: The user wants missing responses to be unmistakable without displaying empty extracted-answer content.

decisions.decision: Show quick-check and unmatched-note summary counters only when their live result count is greater than zero.
decisions.reason: Zero-value alert counters add noise and can look like hardcoded placeholder data.

decisions.decision: Keep the review header wordmark text-only and omit the source-regions-preserved summary badge.
decisions.reason: The user requested a cleaner review header and summary without these decorative elements.
